sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.TagName = 'r' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(T1.Id) * 100 AS percentage
FROM posts AS T1
JOIN tags AS T2 ON T1.Tags LIKE '%' || T2.TagName || '%'
WHERE T1.OwnerDisplayName = 'Community'
